display_long_description:
Step into the dark.
Primal Redux is an atmospheric indie VR horror experience built to test your nerves. Explore chilling corridors, master the shadows with advanced lighting and bloom, and survive the dark using immersive local proximity voice chat.

Whether you're braving the facility alone or communicating with friends in real-time spatial audio, every sound matters, and danger is always close behind.

Key Features:

Immersive Proximity Voice Chat: Talk, whisper, or scream—spatial audio ensures the entity (and other players) hear everything you do.

Atmospheric Horror: Explore a haunting, finely-tuned environment packed with moody lighting, refraction effects, and suspense.

Dynamic Community Hub: Experience an interactive start menu that highlights community supporters directly in-game.

Seasonal Updates: Regular content drops, starting with our massive Halloween event bringing unique cosmetics and eerie new environmental touches.
